title: 2V1 Pass Or Dribble
setup: 10X20 yard area. Two teams on opposite ends.
instructions: The team on attack starts with a pass to the feet, dribble diagonally, and overlap.
Attackers score by dribbling or passing through the end line.
Defender scores by winning the ball and dribbling through the opposite end line.
Keep score, and have the teams switch sides.
coachingPoints: Correct technical execution on the pass, 1st touch, and dribble.
Dribble diagonally to create time and space for the overlapping man.
Proper angle of support depending on how much pressure is on the ball.
Dribbler must decide whether to dribble or pass: be aware what option the defender is taking away, and what option he is giving you.
